Subject: CatalystAI — quick options for a focused 30‑min product intro

Hi Mike —

Great to meet earlier — thanks for the time and for walking through CatalystAI's short list of priorities. Quick recap from our discovery:

- Goal: reduce time-to-insight for model retraining pipelines and lower per-query inference costs while keeping latency under 150ms for the customer-facing endpoints.
- Constraints: on-prem data residency for some datasets, and a preference for predictable unit economics under heavy traffic.
- Success criteria you mentioned: 1) sub-150ms p95 on a 4k token window, 2) cost-per-1k-tokens target, 3) clear plan for private deployment/SOC2 evidence.

Next step we discussed — a focused 30-minute product intro that includes: high-level UI/ops, a 10-minute technical deep-dive (integration + quantization/cost levers), and time for your questions. To make scheduling easiest, can you pick 2 preferred slots from these options (all times PDT):

- Tue Apr 13 — 9:00–9:30am PDT
- Wed Apr 14 — 10:00–10:30am PDT
- Thu Apr 15 — 1:00–1:30pm PDT

Please reply with your top two choices and the names + roles of the CatalystAI attendees (we'll invite the right engineers). I attached a short one-page agenda (30m-demo-agenda.pdf) — it’s a stub with timing so you can suggest tweaks.

Also, flagged: Alex (integration lead) and Dylan (solutions engineer) are cc'd and will join.

Would you like the session recorded?

Thanks,
Naomi Feldman
Senior Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.ai

Attachment: 30m-demo-agenda.pdf (PDF, 1 page)

Naomi
